Hi all — Kim from Finance here. Quick notes on billing and PO handling:

- We can accept invoice-to-PO mapping and place the PO number on the invoice; that's our preferred approach for customers that require PO-first accounting.
- Standard payment terms: Net 30. We can extend to Net 45 for customers under an approved credit arrangement; Net 60 requires a signed payment plan and credit approval — that typically adds 2–3 business days for checks.
- For Marketplace private-offer purchases: invoices are issued by Redwood with the PO on file; if you want Marketplace billing to reconcile automatically with your finance system, we can include the Marketplace order ID on the invoice.
- Required billing info to include on the PO: legal entity name, billing address, tax ID (if applicable), and contact name for AP.

I attached a brief checklist (inlined below) for the PO handoff and the fields we need in the PO. If you can share your PO template (or a sample PO) we will confirm acceptance fields.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
